keyPoints.en: Primary: red, yellow, blue. Secondary: orange (R+Y), green (Y+B), purple (B+R).
keyPoints.bm: Primer: merah, kuning, biru. Sekunder: jingga (M+K), hijau (K+B), ungu (B+M).

keyPoints.en: Complementary (opposites, strong contrast): red–green, blue–orange, yellow–purple.
keyPoints.bm: Pelengkap (bertentangan, kontra kuat): merah–hijau, biru–jingga, kuning–ungu.

keyPoints.en: Analogous (neighbours, harmony); monochromatic (one colour); warm vs cool.
keyPoints.bm: Analogus (bersebelahan, harmoni); monokromatik (satu warna); panas vs sejuk.

keyPoints.en: Tint = + white; shade = + black; tone = + grey.
keyPoints.bm: Tin = + putih; syed = + hitam; ton = + kelabu.

keyPoints.en: Warm colours feel energetic; cool colours feel calm; dark shades feel serious or sad.
keyPoints.bm: Warna panas terasa bertenaga; warna sejuk terasa tenang; syed gelap terasa serius atau sedih.

tip.en: For signs and posters, use strong value contrast for readability.
tip.bm: Untuk papan tanda dan poster, gunakan kontra ton yang kuat supaya mudah dibaca.
